events.what: Echols's tabu-search codes improve bounds in dimensions 32, 33, 34, 37
Takhanov, Yun et al. improve PackingStar's records in dimensions 25-29 and 31 with human geometric techniques

judgement.doubts: Every event is a lower-bound improvement in some dimension; no dimension's exact value was determined, so all are 'bound' (the researcher's competing 'partial' reading is rightly rejected). Under step 4 the ai_role is the strongest among co-equal bound events; AlphaEvolve's dim-11 593 bound is still the record per the record's dispute entry, so 'generated' stands. Tao et al. is a preprint, not expert digestion, but the configuration is explicit and checkable.
